title: oldenlandia richardsonioides var. hirtella
intro: Oldenlandia richardsonioides var. hirtella, commonly known as the hairy-fruited oldenlandia, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is a type of herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in China and other parts of Asia, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, with therapeutic actions including reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia richardsonioides var. hirtella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
